title: What's New: Account Payable Role Center (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to Account Payable Role Center

features.name: Account Payable Role Center
features.description: A new role center for account payable processes that centralizes workflow management related to purchase documents, e-documents, payments, and approvals in one place.
features.status_evidence_quote: First I need to remind you this will be available for 27.1. So that means from November

features.name: Centralized Workflow Management
features.description: Consolidates completed workflow management for account payable processes including purchase documents, e-documents, and payments from multiple sources into one role center.

features.name: Purchase and E-Document Management
features.description: Focused access to ongoing purchase orders and incoming e-documents within the role center, with emphasis on the incoming parts of documents.

features.name: Power BI Reports in Role Center
features.description: Power BI reports related to purchase and account payable processes are directly available within the role center.

features.name: Payable Insights and Analytics
features.description: Multiple charts and insights for account payable analytics including vendor information, overdue documents, payable performance, and age analysis.

features.name: Payment Management and Approvals
features.description: Consolidated access to payment documents, approvals, and intercompany processes within the account payable role center.
